01 / EVIDENCE CONTINUITY

Same effect.
Every witness.

A later observation shouldn’t rewrite the earlier record. Successive readbacks retain separate witnesses, even when they refer to the same effect.

02 / INTENTIONAL DISCLOSURE

Share a smaller surface.

FROM CURIOUS TO HANDS-ON

Your first trace.
Five minutes away.

Install the package, generate synthetic examples, and open an offline report. Then connect your application’s independent readback.

Follow the quickstart ↗

Version 1.1.0 is available on PyPI.
This quickstart performs no real refund or delivery.

quickstart / localPython 3.11+
# 01 — Install the framework
$ python -m pip install consequa-x==1.1.0
# 02 — Generate synthetic captures$ consequa-x demo --output my-demo# 03 — Make an offline report$ consequa-x report \
  my-demo/traces/episode_01.json \
  --output my-report.html
↳ Open my-report.html in your browser.
No model. No credentials. No external calls.
